generic_object_keys: arbitrary admitted NFC JSON strings ordered by UTF-16 code units; typed ContractId fields use their own closed ASCII grammar

integer_profile.syntax: base-10 integers only; fractions and exponent forms forbidden

json_profile: strict RFC 8785 JCS subset over I-JSON without floating point

typed_decimal_profile.syntax: 0 or optional-minus canonical base-10 integer with optional nonzero-terminated fractional part; plus, exponent, leading zeros, trailing fractional zeros, and negative zero forbidden

unicode_profile.object_key_order: lexicographic UTF-16 code units per RFC 8785
